program.section_heading: Career Essentials for the Business World Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Describe the techniques needed to improve career readiness and to secure a job in the business setting.
Recognize the qualities, skills, and abilities of the candidates applying for jobs within the business world.
Create a professional resume, cover letter, and other resources needed for a successful job search.
Describe how to communicate and work cooperatively with individuals in the workplace.
Develop employability skills such as working on a team, problem solving and organizational skills.
Describe how to to respect individual uniqueness in the workplace through diversity, equity and inclusion.
Explain how the changing workplace requires lifelong learning and acquiring new skills.

notes: Noncredit certificate counted in hours: the page prints 'Total Hours 96-108', recorded as total_units in hours.

The section heading is taken from the page's program index entry ('Career Essentials for the Business World Certificate of Completion'); the body text calls it 'The Career Essentials for the Business World Certificate'.

No specific careers or job titles are named; the description refers only generally to careers in the business world.
